common: Boss portrait for a Ukrainian retro-futuristic post-apocalyptic roguelite (2086), painted game illustration, bust framing, muted teal background with a rim light in the boss colour, no text, no watermark.

assets.name: boss-commandant.webp
assets.prompt: Commandant of the Gate: a hulking rusty security-walker robot in a battered peaked commandant cap with amber chevron stripes, one round amber lamp-eye, riveted patched armor, a welded scrap-metal gate with warning lamps behind; muted teal dusk, amber rim light (#f0b369).

assets.name: boss-scrap-press.webp
assets.prompt: The Great Press: a colossal scrap-yard hydraulic press with a crushing plate like a flat grim face, two piston arms, compressed car cubes, venting steam, dusty-pink warning lights (#d995a3); muted teal industrial yard.

assets.name: boss-signalman.webp
assets.prompt: Patrol Dispatcher: a tall slender signal-tower robot with headset, antennas and dishes on its head, one pale cyan visor-eye (#81c8e7), a signal-flare pistol, small patrol drones circling, tram-line markings; muted teal night street.

assets.name: boss-root-mother.webp
assets.prompt: Mother of the Greenhouses: a towering machine-plant matriarch, a gardener-robot torso overgrown with root-like cables and vines, green glow (#a2d883), cracked greenhouse glass, watering can and pruning shears fused into her arms.

assets.name: boss-irrigator.webp
assets.prompt: Supreme Irrigator: a huge irrigation machine with a face of a brass valve-wheel and two pressure-gauge eyes, a crown of rotating sprinkler nozzles throwing teal water arcs (#77d6c1), water-hammer arm, overgrown greenhouse rows.

assets.name: boss-queen.webp
assets.prompt: Queen of the Nursery: a regal hive-like seedling-nursery machine with a crown of rusty pipes and golden honeycomb seed trays, a polished brass face, mechanical sprayer-wasps on her shoulders, honey-gold light (#d8bf79).

assets.name: boss-architect.webp
assets.prompt: Demolition Architect: a slender drafting-robot with a compass-like head, one cyan lens-eye (#8ddbf0), projecting a laser blueprint grid, a wrecking-ball arm, rolled blueprints and a hard hat, in a dim server hall.

assets.name: boss-collector.webp
assets.prompt: Network Collector: a debt-collector machine of stacked coins and cable bundles with a large ledger as a shield, a faceted violet eye (#c6a3e9), coin rings orbiting like halos, bankruptcy stamps for hands.

assets.name: boss-chronarch.webp
assets.prompt: Keeper of 04:17: a clockwork guardian with a huge wall clock frozen at four seventeen as its torso, brass gears and pendulum, gaunt metal face with orange eyes (#ffc38a), echo copies of its outline, ripples of time, a flickering stairwell lamp.
